title.narrative: North East Balqa wastewater project

description.narrative: The Action consists of a wastewater network and a treatment plant which will collect and treat the wastewater generated by the communities located to the North-East of As-Salt city in the Balqa governorate. The Action will provide a new treatment plant that will replace the existing overloaded treatment plant.
